node: Domestic manufacturing networks, quick-turn prototyping, and additive manufacturing capacity
summary: Research-only Layer 1B universe expansion for the administrative/qualification chokepoint between defense/government requirements and fragmented domestic manufacturing capacity. The pass prioritizes US-listed small/mid-cap names tied to digital manufacturing networks, quick-turn prototyping, additive manufacturing, ITAR/AS9100 quality gates, and defense/aerospace qualification workflows.
